name: CoinGecko
label: CoinGecko
description: CoinGecko official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: coin_list, coin_get, coin_price, coin_markets, coin_market_chart, coin_ohlc, coin_history. Docs: https://docs.coingecko.com/demo/reference/authentication. CoinGecko API terms. Demo host https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3 + header x-cg-demo-api-key. Events endpoints omitted (deprecated). Not an exchange. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One CoinGecko request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"coin_list"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: coin_list | coin_get | coin_price | coin_markets | coin_market_chart | coin_ohlc | coin_history. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'coin_list'.

schema.label: date
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `date` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: days
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `days` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: include_platform

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: coin_list, coin_get, coin_price, coin_markets, coin_market_chart, coin_ohlc, coin_history.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `header`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
